verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֣א מוּעָף֮ לַאֲשֶׁ֣ר מוּצָ֣ק לָהּ֒ הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן כָּעֵ֣ת הֵקַ֞ל אַ֤רְצָה זְבֻלוּן֙ וְאַ֣רְצָה נַפְתָּלִ֔י וְהָאַחֲר֖וֹן הִכְבִּ֑יד דֶּ֤רֶךְ הַיָּם֙ עֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן גְּלִ֖יל הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō mū·‘āp̄ la·’ă·šer mū·ṣāq lāh hā·ri·šō·wn kā·‘êṯ hê·qal ’ar·ṣāh zə·ḇu·lūn wə·’ar·ṣāh nap̄·tā·lî wə·hā·’a·ḥă·rō·wn hiḵ·bîḏ de·reḵ hay·yām ‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên gə·lîl hag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: Nevertheless there will be no more gloom for those in distress In the past . . . He humbled the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali but in the future He will honor the Way of the Sea beyond the Jordan Galilee of the nations

verses.original: הָעָם֙ הַהֹלְכִ֣ים בַּחֹ֔שֶׁךְ רָא֖וּ גָּד֑וֹל א֣וֹר עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃ יֹשְׁבֵי֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ צַלְמָ֔וֶת א֖וֹר נָגַ֥הּ
verses.transliteration: hā·‘ām ha·hō·lə·ḵîm ba·ḥō·šeḵ rā·’ū gā·ḏō·wl ’ō·wr ‘ă·lê·hem yō·šə·ḇê bə·’e·reṣ ṣal·mā·weṯ ’ō·wr nā·ḡah
verses.literal: The people walking in darkness have seen a great light on those living in the land of the shadow of death a light has dawned

verses.original: הִרְבִּ֣יתָ הַגּ֔וֹי לֹא הִגְדַּ֣לְתָּ הַשִּׂמְחָ֑ה שָׂמְח֤וּ לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙ כְּשִׂמְחַ֣ת בַּקָּצִ֔יר כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יָגִ֖ילוּ בְּחַלְּקָ֥ם שָׁלָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hir·bî·ṯā hag·gō·w lō hiḡ·dal·tā haś·śim·ḥāh śā·mə·ḥū lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā kə·śim·ḥaṯ baq·qā·ṣîr ka·’ă·šer yā·ḡî·lū bə·ḥal·lə·qām šā·lāl
verses.literal: You have enlarged the nation . . . and increased its joy The people rejoice before You as they rejoice at harvest time as [men] rejoice in dividing the plunder

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ אֶת־ כְּי֥וֹם מִדְיָֽן׃ הַחִתֹּ֖תָ עֹ֣ל סֻבֳּל֗וֹ וְאֵת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה שִׁכְמ֔וֹ שֵׁ֖בֶט הַנֹּגֵ֣שׂ בּ֑וֹ
verses.transliteration: kî ’eṯ- kə·yō·wm miḏ·yān ha·ḥit·tō·ṯā ‘ōl sub·bo·lōw wə·’êṯ maṭ·ṭêh šiḵ·mōw šê·ḇeṭ han·nō·ḡêś bōw
verses.literal: For - as in the day of Midian You have shattered the yoke of their burden - the bar [across] their shoulders and the rod of their oppressor . . .

verses.original: כִּ֤י כָל־ סֹאֵ֣ן סְאוֹן֙ בְּרַ֔עַשׁ וְשִׂמְלָ֖ה מְגוֹלָלָ֣ה בְדָמִ֑ים וְהָיְתָ֥ה לִשְׂרֵפָ֖ה מַאֲכֹ֥לֶת אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵāl sō·’ên sə·’ō·wn bə·ra·‘aš wə·śim·lāh mə·ḡō·w·lā·lāh ḇə·ḏā·mîm wə·hā·yə·ṯāh liś·rê·p̄āh ma·’ă·ḵō·leṯ ’êš
verses.literal: For every trampling boot of battle and [every] garment rolled in blood will be burned as fuel for the fire

verses.original: כִּי־ לָ֗נוּ יֶ֣לֶד יֻלַּד־ לָ֔נוּ בֵּ֚ן נִתַּן־ הַמִּשְׂרָ֖ה וַתְּהִ֥י עַל־ שִׁכְמ֑וֹ וַיִּקְרָ֨א שְׁמ֜וֹ פֶּ֠לֶא יוֹעֵץ֙ גִּבּ֔וֹר אֵ֣ל אֲבִיעַ֖ד שַׂר־ שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- lā·nū ye·leḏ yul·laḏ- lā·nū bên nit·tan- ham·miś·rāh wat·tə·hî ‘al- šiḵ·mōw way·yiq·rā šə·mōw pe·le yō·w·‘êṣ gib·bō·wr ’êl ’ă·ḇî·‘aḏ śar- šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: For unto us a child is born unto us a son is given and the government will be upon His shoulders And He will be called . . . Wonderful Counselor Mighty God Everlasting Father Prince of Peace

verses.original: לְםַרְבֵּה הַמִּשְׂרָ֜ה וּלְשָׁל֣וֹם אֵֽין־ קֵ֗ץ עַל־ כִּסֵּ֤א דָוִד֙ וְעַל־ מַמְלַכְתּ֔וֹ לְהָכִ֤ין אֹתָהּ֙ וּֽלְסַעֲדָ֔הּ בְּמִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּבִצְדָקָ֑ה מֵעַתָּה֙ וְעַד־ עוֹלָ֔ם קִנְאַ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה־ זֹּֽאת׃ס
verses.transliteration: lə·mar·bēh ham·miś·rāh ū·lə·šā·lō·wm ’ên- qêṣ ‘al- kis·sê ḏā·wiḏ wə·‘al- mam·laḵ·tōw lə·hā·ḵîn ’ō·ṯāh ū·lə·sa·‘ă·ḏāh bə·miš·pāṭ ū·ḇiṣ·ḏā·qāh mê·‘at·tāh wə·‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām qin·’aṯ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ta·‘ă·śeh- zōṯ
verses.literal: Of the increase of [His] government and peace [there will be] no end He will reign on the throne of David and over his kingdom to establish - and sustain it with justice and righteousness from that time and forevermore . . . The zeal of the LORD of Hosts will accomplish this

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֖י שָׁלַ֥ח דָּבָ֛ר בְּיַעֲקֹ֑ב וְנָפַ֖ל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nāy šā·laḥ dā·ḇār bə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·nā·p̄al bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: The Lord has sent a message against Jacob and it has fallen upon Israel

verses.original: כֻּלּ֔וֹ הָעָ֣ם וְיָדְעוּ֙ אֶפְרַ֖יִם וְיוֹשֵׁ֣ב שֹׁמְר֑וֹן בְּגַאֲוָ֛ה וּבְגֹ֥דֶל לֵבָ֖ב לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kul·lōw hā·‘ām wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū ’ep̄·ra·yim wə·yō·wō·šêḇ šō·mə·rō·wn bə·ḡa·’ă·wāh ū·ḇə·ḡō·ḏel lê·ḇāḇ lê·mōr
verses.literal: All the people will know it Ephraim and the dwellers of Samaria With pride and arrogance of heart they will say

verses.original: לְבֵנִ֥ים נָפָ֖לוּ נִבְנֶ֑ה וְגָזִ֣ית שִׁקְמִ֣ים גֻּדָּ֔עוּ נַחֲלִֽיף׃ וַאֲרָזִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: lə·ḇê·nîm nā·p̄ā·lū niḇ·neh wə·ḡā·zîṯ šiq·mîm gud·dā·‘ū na·ḥă·lîp̄ wa·’ă·rā·zîm
verses.literal: The bricks have fallen but we will rebuild with finished stone the sycamores have been felled but we will replace them with cedars

verses.original: יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ וַיְשַׂגֵּ֧ב צָרֵ֥י רְצִ֖ין עָלָ֑יו וְאֶת־ יְסַכְסֵֽךְ׃ אֹיְבָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’eṯ- way·śag·gêḇ ṣā·rê rə·ṣîn ‘ā·lāw wə·’eṯ- yə·saḵ·sêḵ ’ō·yə·ḇāw
verses.literal: The LORD - has raised up the foes of Rezin against him - and joined his enemies {together}

verses.original: אֲרָ֣ם מִקֶּ֗דֶם וּפְלִשְׁתִּים֙ מֵֽאָח֔וֹר וַיֹּאכְל֥וּ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּכָל־ פֶּ֑ה בְּכָל־ זֹאת֙ אַפּ֔וֹ לֹא־ שָׁ֣ב יָד֥וֹ וְע֖וֹד נְטוּיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·rām miq·qe·ḏem ū·p̄ə·liš·tîm mê·’ā·ḥō·wr way·yō·ḵə·lū ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl bə·ḵāl peh bə·ḵāl zōṯ ’ap·pōw lō- šāḇ yā·ḏōw wə·‘ō·wḏ nə·ṭū·yāh
verses.literal: Aram from the east and Philistia from the west have devoured - Israel with open mouths Despite all this His anger is not turned away His hand is still upraised

verses.original: וְהָעָ֥ם לֹא־ שָׁ֖ב עַד־ הַמַּכֵּ֑הוּ וְאֶת־ לֹ֥א דָרָֽשׁוּ׃ס יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·‘ām lō- šāḇ ‘aḏ- ham·mak·kê·hū wə·’eṯ- lō ḏā·rā·šū Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: But the people did not return to Him who struck them - they did not seek the LORD of Hosts

verses.original: יְהוָ֜ה וַיַּכְרֵ֨ת מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֗ל רֹ֧אשׁ וְזָנָ֛ב כִּפָּ֥ה וְאַגְמ֖וֹן אֶחָֽד׃ י֥וֹם
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yaḵ·rêṯ mî·yiś·rā·’êl rōš wə·zā·nāḇ kip·pāh wə·’aḡ·mō·wn ’e·ḥāḏ yō·wm
verses.literal: So the LORD will cut off Israel’s head and tail [both] palm branch and reed in a single day

verses.original: הָרֹ֑אשׁ זָקֵ֥ן וּנְשׂוּא־ פָנִ֖ים ה֣וּא הַזָּנָֽב׃ וְנָבִ֥יא ה֥וּא מֽוֹרֶה־ שֶּׁ֖קֶר
verses.transliteration: hā·rōš zā·qên ū·nə·śū- p̄ā·nîm hū haz·zā·nāḇ wə·nā·ḇî hū mō·w·reh- še·qer
verses.literal: The head is the elder and honorable man and the tail is the prophet - who teaches lies

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְי֛וּ מְאַשְּׁרֵ֥י הָֽעָם־ הַזֶּ֖ה מַתְעִ֑ים וּמְאֻשָּׁרָ֖יו מְבֻלָּעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū mə·’aš·šə·rê hā·‘ām- haz·zeh maṯ·‘îm ū·mə·’uš·šā·rāw mə·ḇul·lā·‘îm
verses.literal: For those who guide this people . . . mislead them and those they mislead are swallowed up

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֨ן אֲדֹנָ֗י וְאֶת־ לֹֽא־ יִשְׂמַ֣ח׀ עַל־ בַּחוּרָ֜יו לֹ֣א יְרַחֵ֔ם יְתֹמָ֤יו וְאֶת־ אַלְמְנֹתָיו֙ כִּ֤י כֻלּוֹ֙ חָנֵ֣ף וּמֵרַ֔ע וְכָל־ פֶּ֖ה דֹּבֵ֣ר נְבָלָ֑ה בְּכָל־ זֹאת֙ אַפּ֔וֹ לֹא־ שָׁ֣ב יָד֥וֹ וְע֖וֹד נְטוּיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên ’ă·ḏō·nāy wə·’eṯ- lō- yiś·maḥ ‘al- ba·ḥū·rāw lō yə·ra·ḥêm yə·ṯō·māw wə·’eṯ- ’al·mə·nō·ṯāw kî ḵul·lōw ḥā·nêp̄ ū·mê·ra‘ wə·ḵāl peh dō·ḇêr nə·ḇā·lāh bə·ḵāl zōṯ ’ap·pōw lō- šāḇ yā·ḏōw wə·‘ō·wḏ nə·ṭū·yāh
verses.literal: Therefore . . . the Lord - takes no pleasure in their young men He has no compassion on their fatherless and widows For every one of them is godless and wicked and every mouth speaks folly Despite all this His anger is not turned away His hand is still upraised

verses.original: כִּֽי־ רִשְׁעָ֔ה בָעֲרָ֤ה כָאֵשׁ֙ תֹּאכֵ֑ל וָשַׁ֖יִת שָׁמִ֥יר וַתִּצַּת֙ הַיַּ֔עַר בְּסִֽבְכֵ֣י וַיִּֽתְאַבְּכ֖וּ גֵּא֥וּת עָשָֽׁן׃
verses.transliteration: kî- riš·‘āh ḇā·‘ă·rāh ḵā·’êš tō·ḵêl wā·ša·yiṯ šā·mîr wat·tiṣ·ṣaṯ hay·ya·‘ar bə·siḇ·ḵê way·yiṯ·’ab·bə·ḵū gê·’ūṯ ‘ā·šān
verses.literal: For wickedness burns like a fire that consumes the thorns and briers and kindles the forest thickets which roll upward in billows of smoke

verses.original: בְּעֶבְרַ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אָ֑רֶץ נֶעְתַּ֣ם הָעָם֙ וַיְהִ֤י כְּמַאֲכֹ֣לֶת אֵ֔שׁ לֹ֥א אִ֥ישׁ יַחְמֹֽלוּ׃ אֶל־ אָחִ֖יו
verses.transliteration: bə·‘eḇ·raṯ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ā·reṣ ne‘·tam hā·‘ām way·hî kə·ma·’ă·ḵō·leṯ ’êš lō ’îš yaḥ·mō·lū ’el- ’ā·ḥîw
verses.literal: By the wrath of the LORD of Hosts the land is scorched and the people are fuel for the fire No man even spares . . . his brother

verses.original: וַיִּגְזֹ֤ר עַל־ יָמִין֙ וְרָעֵ֔ב וַיֹּ֥אכַל עַל־ שְׂמֹ֖אול וְלֹ֣א שָׂבֵ֑עוּ אִ֥ישׁ יֹאכֵֽלוּ׃ בְּשַׂר־ זְרֹע֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: way·yiḡ·zōr ‘al- yā·mîn wə·rā·‘êḇ way·yō·ḵal ‘al- śə·mō·wl wə·lō śā·ḇê·‘ū ’îš yō·ḵê·lū bə·śar- zə·rō·‘ōw
verses.literal: They carve out what is on the right but they are still hungry they eat what is on the left but they are still not satisfied Each one devours the flesh of his own offspring

verses.original: מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה אֶת־ אֶפְרַ֗יִם וְאֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ אֶת־ מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה יַחְדָּ֥ו הֵ֖מָּה עַל־ יְהוּדָ֑ה בְּכָל־ זֹאת֙ אַפּ֔וֹ לֹא־ שָׁ֣ב יָד֥וֹ וְע֖וֹד נְטוּיָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: mə·naš·šeh ’eṯ- ’ep̄·ra·yim wə·’ep̄·ra·yim ’eṯ- mə·naš·šeh yaḥ·dāw hêm·māh ‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh bə·ḵāl zōṯ ’ap·pōw lō- šāḇ yā·ḏōw wə·‘ō·wḏ nə·ṭū·yāh
verses.literal: Manasseh - [devours] Ephraim and Ephraim - Manasseh together . . . they turn against Judah Despite all this His anger is not turned away His hand is still upraised
